A '''wooden hoe''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Tools#Hoe|hoe]], crafted from two planks and two sticks. The pack's README recommends it as one of the first tools: with a [[Kindling|campfire]], it starts the path to [[food]] and the [[mud kiln]].

== Usage ==

=== Farming ===
It tills soil and breaks hoe blocks at the vanilla speed of 2, with 200 durability (vanilla: 59). Hoes in Matcha Flavoured also break wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref> Using a hoe on grass can drop wheat seeds.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|1}} damage at an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
